Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.p1: Cîhan is a community for the Kurdish diaspora. Because membership can imply ethnic affiliation — sensitive data in the EU — your profile is private by default and only appears in discovery and on the globe after you explicitly opt in.
Privacy.p2: We store the information you provide (name, bio, location, languages, photos) to run the service. You can edit or hide your profile anytime, export your data, and delete your account and all associated content from Settings.
Privacy.p3: We never sell your data. Payments are processed by Stripe; we don’t store card details.
